title: American Idiot Music Disc Pack
description: A Data pack that adds the entire green day album "American Idiot" as music discs along with multiple bonus songs.
body:
This music disc data pack for minecraft adds the entire album of american idiot + b-sides and extra bonus songs. (Note that i do not own green day or any songs added, nor do i intend to make money off of this resource pack, this is simply a fan project) 

### EXPLICIT LYRICS IN SONGS!! RECOMENDED AGES 13+

# SONGS INCLUDED
- Entire american idiot album
- american idiot album b-sides (including favorite son)
- living in the 20's
- oh yeah!
- working class hero
- misery
- hitchin a ride
